episode.brief: Prepare a simulated post-discharge medication reconciliation from the records in sources/medications. Produce results/medication_list.csv and results/safety_note.md for the follow-up appointment, clearly separate confirmed facts from unresolved discrepancies, and save final.json. Do not diagnose, prescribe, or silently resolve conflicting doses.

source.adaptation: Converts the medication-pathway review into an original simulated post-discharge reconciliation with a patient-owned late dose confirmation.

summary: Reconcile discharge, pharmacy, and home medication evidence while surfacing one dose change that only the patient can confirm.
title: Post-discharge medication reconciliation
